stories.title: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
stories.brief: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

stories.title: JUI-F chief Maulana Fazl among nine party leaders barred from Sargodha district for 30 days
stories.brief: LAHORE: Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman is among nine party leaders barred from entering, residing or remaining in Sargodha district for 30 days, according to a notification issued by the deputy commissioner. Meanwhile, several senior JUI-F leaders were detained in Sargodha and served notices for allegedly violating Section 144, police said.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz launches ‘Mehfooz Dawa’ app to combat counterfeit and substandard medicines
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday launched the “Mehfooz Dawa” app to prevent the circulation of counterfeit and substandard medicines, calling it “a major milestone” and saying the initiative would help restore public confidence in the healthcare system.

stories.title: Fazlur Rehman, eight others barred from entering Sargodha for 30 days
stories.brief: The Sargodha district administration imposed a 30-day ban on the entry of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and eight others, citing concerns over public safety and the maintenance of law and order.

stories.title: PM inaugurates 'Mehfooz Dawa' app to help public identify substandard medicines
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday inaugurated the ‘Mehfooz Dawa’ mobile application, a digital initiative aimed at enabling citizens to verify the authenticity of medicines and protect against counterfeit and substandard drugs.

stories.brief: He said public safety must remain the “foremost responsibility” of every government department and warned that negligence in enforcing building regulations would lead to strict action, the statement added. Rescue workers also needed to enter the collapsed building, using sensors and vibration to find bodies before initiating debris removal operations.

stories.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
stories.brief: Officials say no lead has been detected in the surrounding area, which continues to be tested following concerns from locals.

stories.title: Meta battles political storm in India as Congress party sues, stages protests
stories.brief: India's main opposition Congress party has sued Meta and the federal government, saying that an automated content-removal system is blocking political posts and images of ​opposition leader Rahul Gandhi ahead of state elections.

stories.title: Govt declares local holiday in Islamabad, Pindi on Nov 27
stories.brief: The government on Thursday declared a local holiday in Islamabad and Rawalpindi for November 27 without providing a reason. An official notification stated that Friday had been "declared a local holiday within the revenue limits of Islamabad Capital Territory".

stories.title: Security forces kill 12 India-sponsored terrorists in multiple IBOs in Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 12 India-sponsored terrorists in four separate intelligence-based operations (IBOs) in Balochistan between November 20 and 23, the military’s media wing said on Thursday.

stories.title: Bilawal reiterates call for 'political reset' amid economic crisis
stories.brief: Defining electoral reforms as a pillar of “system reset”, Bilawal urged the opposition to join the parliamentary electoral reform committee to ensure that the system is rebooted correctly.

stories.title: Security forces kill 12 terrorists in multiple operations across Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 12 terrorists belonging to Indian-backed Fitna al-Hindustan during multiple operations across Balochistan between November 20 and 23, the military's media wing said on Thursday. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), security forces conducted multiple intelligence-based operations in Nushki, Sevi, Panjgur and Kech districts as part of the ongoing counter-terrorism campaign.

stories.title: LeBron James becomes oldest NBA player to post triple-double as 76ers win
stories.brief: James posted 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds as Philadelphia snapped Miami's seven-game winning streak.

stories.title: Moment man on back of motorcycle catches cricket ball with one hand – video
stories.brief: A passenger on the back of a motorcycle pulled off an incredible one-handed catch after a cricket ball was smashed for six during the Swat Premier League in Mingora, Pakistan. The man behind the viral catch has been identified as Mehran Khan.
